description: Na₂Sn₂C₃(O₂F)₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to one O and four F atoms to form edge-sharing NaOF₄ trigonal bipyramids. The Na-O bond length is 2.45 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.47 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to four O and three F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.82 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three O and one F atom. There are a spread of Sn-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.47 Å. The Sn-F bond length is 2.10 Å. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two O and two F atoms. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and one longer (2.51 Å) Sn-O bond length. There is one shorter (2.10 Å) and one longer (2.15 Å) Sn-F bond length. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.25 Å) and one longer (1.29 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.27 Å) C-O bond length. In the third C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Sn and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Sn and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sn, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one C atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Sn atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Sn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Sn atom to form distorted edge-sharing FNa₃Sn trigonal pyramids.
